summary: Final pre-deploy Spanish localization + Private-appointments regression on VIsita EMR preview. Verified end-to-end via Playwright with linda.nguyen@demo.com (Private), maria.lopez@demo.com (OHIP), and staff@visita.demo. All spec-critical items pass: (1) Sign In, Register (role-picker step 1), Forgot Password render in ES. (2) Patient Portal fully ES post-login for both Private and OHIP patients — bottom nav Inicio/Citas/Recetas/Mensajes/Solicitudes/Facturas/Perfil all present. Language survives login and full reload (localStorage visita_lang=es persists). EN/ES toggle in portal header switches live. (3) Private Appointments banner exactly matches spec: PRIVADO badge (no UNINSURED / SIN SEGURO), ES phrase 'El médico generalmente atiende a pacientes privados por la tarde-noche:' present, NO 'Aguayo' in banner, private_hours 'Monday–Wednesday, 5:30 PM–9:00 PM' correctly localized to 'Lunes–Miércoles, 5:30 PM–9:00 PM' (day names translated, times unchanged). (4) Mobile 390px viewport: pref-date + pref-time both 316px wide and vertically stacked (date_y=793, time_y=873); at 800px tablet they render side-by-side (same y=602). (5) Reason cascade first-level placeholder 'Seleccione un motivo…' in ES; localized labels via reasonLabels.* keys. (6) Invoices: neutral subtitle 'Sus facturas de servicios y detalles de pago.', EXACTLY ONE '¿Por qué hay un cargo?' reason box per invoice (15 boxes for 15 invoices for Linda), private-pay wording renders correctly and mentions OHIP by contrast (scoped to private-pay), OHIP-uninsured wording 'Esta factura es por un servicio que no está cubierto por su cobertura de OHIP.' shown for OHIP invoices. (7) Internal staff portal at /internal renders entirely in ENGLISH (Hub, Patients, Rx, Referrals, Imaging, Bloodwork, Messages, Appointments, Private Requests, Billing, Calendar, Intercom, Verifications, Applications, Organizations, Providers) even when visita_lang=es. (8) Backend /api/config/private returns valid data; /api/auth/login OK; overview confirms patient_type=private for Linda. Regression suites from prior iterations (test_regression_iter42, test_private_window_guard, test_dob_age_validation, test_pharmacy_rx) were not re-run in this iteration — spec targets Spanish localization surface which is UI-driven. Recommend main agent run those suites once before deploy for full regression coverage.

issues: Month header 'October 2026' and weekday headers 'Su Mo Tu We Th Fr Sa' render in English inside the shadcn Calendar component when visita_lang=es. Times/dates parsing unchanged. Low priority — calendar is patient-facing UI chrome; consider setting react-day-picker locale from i18n.language.
Status label 'NOT SPECIFIED' appears in English on some appointment cards inside ES portal (see APT-000001 card). Likely a status enum rendered without translation. Low priority.

When a staff user logs in with localStorage visita_lang=es (a residual patient preference from a prior session on the same device), the success toast reads 'Bienvenido de nuevo, Kevin' even though the internal portal UI itself is fully English. Cosmetic — internal portals otherwise remain English per spec.

action_items: (Optional / low priority) Localize the shadcn Calendar component (month + weekday headers) using i18n.language for ES patients on /portal/appointments.
(Optional / low priority) Localize appointment status enum labels (e.g. 'NOT SPECIFIED') on portal appointment cards.
(Optional) Consider forcing internal-role logins to reset visita_lang to 'en' so toasts don't render Spanish for staff/admin users.

Before deploy: main agent should re-run existing regression suites (test_regression_iter42.py, test_private_window_guard.py, test_dob_age_validation.py, test_pharmacy_rx.py) to complete full pre-deploy sign-off. This iteration focused only on the localization + contextual-invoice + private-banner surface described in the request.
critical_code_review_comments: PortalPrivateAppointments.jsx localizeHours() implementation is clean and defensive: bails out on non-ES lang, uses word-boundary regex, preserves times and unrecognized clinic prose. Good.
Reason cascade correctly uses t(`reasonLabels.${node.label}`, node.label) with English fallback — submits raw reason codes so business logic unchanged. Good.
PortalPrivateAppointments grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 works as intended (confirmed at 390px and 800px viewport widths).
Invoice reason resolver correctly renders exactly one reason box per invoice; private-pay copy contrasts with OHIP by design.
server.py still ~4,100+ lines — long-standing refactor advice from iter42/43/44 still applies. Non-blocking for this deploy.
shadcn Calendar on /portal/appointments does not accept an i18n locale prop today — consider passing locale from date-fns/locale/es to react-day-picker for full ES coverage. Non-blocking.

success_rate.frontend: ~97% — all spec-critical items pass; 3 low-priority cosmetic gaps noted
